VERG: Brooklyn’s Trusted Emergency & Specialty Veterinarians & Animal Hospital
For 20 years (and counting!), VERG Brooklyn has been the heartbeat of emergency and specialty veterinary care in New York. Founded in 2005 to fill a critical gap in Brooklyn’s emergency veterinary services, we’ve grown into a 24/7 lifeline for pets and the people who love them. Added to our extensive emergency and specialty knowledge is our Fear Free skillset.
As a
Fear Free Certified Veterinary Practice
, you can rest easy knowing that we go the extra mile to ensure your pet feels safe and secure.
Whether it’s a midnight crisis or a complex medical case requiring board-certified expertise, our veterinarians and team are ready—combining cutting-edge medicine with the warmth and dedication of a neighborhood animal hospital. Because here, every pet matters, every second counts, and every family is welcome.
Our Specialty & Emergency Veterinary Services
At VERG, your pet’s health is in expert hands. Every case we see, from heartwrenching emergencies to head-scratching diseases, receives the highest level of attention and expertise. Our team of board-certified specialists, experienced emergency veterinarians, and devoted veterinary technicians work together to provide comprehensive, advanced treatment under one roof. Because when your pet needs us, we’re always here.
Our animal hospital provides the following emergency and specialty services:
24/7 Emergency
& Critical Care
Surgery
Internal Medicine
Neurology
Cardiology
Oncology
Diagnostic Imaging
Anesthesia
If you have questions about any of our specialty services, please reach out!
Call Us (718) 522-9400
Emergency Veterinarian in
Brooklyn, NY
Emergencies don’t keep office hours, and neither do we. At VERG Brooklyn, we’re always on duty—day or night, rain or shine, weekends and holidays. When the unexpected happens, our emergency and critical care team is standing by, ready to provide immediate, life-saving treatment with cutting-edge technology and expert hands.
Our ER team does their best to ease your worries by providing top-tier care, innovative equipment, and the warmth and compassion you’d expect from a close friend. Curious what you can expect if your pet experiences an emergency?
Appointments Not Necessary
No appointments, no waiting for tomorrow—just walk in
Get the Answers You Need
On-site advanced diagnostics for rapid answers (X-ray, ultrasound, CT, and lab testing)
Intensive Care for the Most Fragile Cases
Your pet will have access to ventilation, oxygen therapy, blood transfusions, and more
We Have Board-Certified Specialists
Every department is headed by board-certified specialists to ensure the highest level of care
Your pet’s emergency is our priority—because in their most critical moments, they deserve the very best. Call ahead or come straight in. We’ll be ready.

Community & Compassion at Our Core
Caring for Brooklyn’s pets means caring for the people who love them. Through nonprofit work, local events, and grief support services, we’re committed to making a difference.
Grief Support for All
Christine Galotti Noyes, LCSW, VSW serves as the Veterinary Social Worker at VERG Brooklyn and provides compassionate, trauma-informed support to both animal caregivers and veterinary staff. Her work includes supporting animal caregivers through grief, loss, and emotionally complex medical experiences, as well as supporting staff mental health through consultation, emotional processing, and guidance related to compassion fatigue and secondary trauma. These services are available exclusively to VERG Brooklyn clients and staff and are designed to support the emotional well-being of all those involved in an animal companion’s care.
Ask for Help
(opens in new tab)
Positive Tails
Positive Tails is an organization devoted to helping pets in need get the medical care they deserve, no matter the cost. Founded by our own Dr. Brett Levitzke, our mission is centered around the belief that pets are part of our families, and we’re committed to keeping families together.
Donate Now
Local Events & CE
From Pride events to continuing education for veterinary professionals, we’re passionate about giving back to the community that has embraced us for 20 years. By creating an inclusive space where everyone is welcome, we make a positive impact on pets and the families who love them.
